auto_merge.commit_message:
This PR introduces `cython.likely()`/`cython.unlikely()` allowing user to provide the compiler with branch prediction information.

Fixes #7667

---------

Co-authored-by: scoder <stefan_ml@behnel.de>

repo.description: The most widely used Python to C compiler
repo.name: cython

body:
This is alternative to #7803 but without the need of having separate BranchHintNode class.

~The downside of this implementation that cannot be explicitly asserted whether branch hint was generated.~

Fixes #7667

comment_data.body: Instead of rejecting this, it should be trivial to add a `branch_hint` attribute to `CondExprNode` in the same way as `IfClauseNode`. Could you do that?
comment_data.diff_hunk:
@@ -1,20 +1,37 @@
 # mode: error
 
+import cython
+
 cdef void foo():
-	cdef int bool, int1
-	cdef char *ptr2
-	cdef int *ptr3
-	cdef object i = 5
+    cdef int bool, int1
+    cdef char *ptr2
+    cdef int *ptr3
+    cdef object i = 5
+
+    bool = i == ptr2  # evaluated in Python space
+    bool = ptr3 == i # error
+    bool = int1 == ptr2 # error
+    bool = ptr2 == ptr3 # error
+
+    bool = 1 in 2 in 3
+
 
-	bool = i == ptr2  # evaluated in Python space
-	bool = ptr3 == i # error
-	bool = int1 == ptr2 # error
-	bool = ptr2 == ptr3 # error
+cdef void likely_foo(int j):
+    cdef bint bol
+    cdef int i = 5
 
-	bool = 1 in 2 in 3
+    bol = cython.likely(i == j)
+    bol = cython.unlikely(i == j)
+    a = i if cython.likely(j > 5) else -i

comment_data.body: This can be done much earlier, at the beginning of the method. There is really nothing to do here if there is an explicit branch hint already.
Fixed as part of the branch update.
I think it is done. Maybe some finetuning/polishing can be done but the logic is there.
